landing.name: Landing
landing.log_start: The founders have landed at Jezero. Air, water, food and power are everything.
landing.log_fall_back: The easy days are over. The colony is back to simply getting by.

settlement.name: Settlement
settlement.log_enter: The founders are no longer only surviving. The colony has settled.
settlement.log_enter_again: The colony has found its footing again. Life has a rhythm once more.
